newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at high, fuelled by dollar.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at high, fuelled by dollar.

text.p: Sweden's bourse climbed to an all-time high on Tuesday, fuelled by gains in the dollar and a rally on Wall Street as the Dow Jones rebounds.
The forestry sector was in the spotlight, leading the market as it climbed 4.1 percent.

The Stockholm general index rose 1.63 percent to a record 2,321.28 after relatively active turnover worth 5.0 billion crowns. "Everyone's running in the same direction - fast," one broker told Reuters.
Forestry shares saw good gains but analysts saw this as a catch up and expected them to be shortlived.
MoDo climbed 8.5 crowns to 193.5 and AssiDoman ended eight higher at 185 crowns.
Blue chip stocks posted gains. Ericsson rose three crowns to 208.5 crowns.
Drugs major Astra jumped 8.5 to 334.5 crowns following Monday's news that it had won FDA approval for wider use of its anti-ulcer drug Losec. Astra, however, said the approval would not affect sales.
Appliance maker Electrolux jumped 20.5 crowns to 420 after Monday figures indicated a pick-up of the currently sluggish domestic consumption.
